reason: Operationalize the preregistered TRAIN-selected moving-block bootstrap length in wall-clock time for a multi-market panel.

block_length_selection.input: For each frozen coordinate, use TRAIN complete-case target rows only.
block_length_selection.aggregation: Within each factual event window, aggregate target values to 1-minute UTC means; never concatenate across an event boundary for lag pairs.
block_length_selection.autocorrelation: For each integer lag 5..60 minutes, form within-event paired minute means, demean within event, pool valid paired products/variances, and compute the pooled Pearson autocorrelation.
block_length_selection.selection: Choose the first lag whose absolute autocorrelation is <0.10. If no lag qualifies or support is insufficient, use 60 minutes.
block_length_selection.freeze_stage: Record one block_length_minutes per frozen coordinate in the TRAIN+DEV fit-freeze manifest before HOLDOUT.

holdout_bootstrap.unit: 1-minute mean baseline-minus-challenger loss improvement within factual event window
holdout_bootstrap.resampling: Moving contiguous blocks of the frozen length independently within each event window.
holdout_bootstrap.aggregation: Compute one mean per event window per draw and average event-window means equally; also report the raw observation-weighted mean separately as a descriptive metric.
holdout_bootstrap.seed_rule: deterministic from the master seed plus frozen coordinate identity
